title: test(server): share repeated boots in four server test files and budget the 17 files between 10 and 13 s
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XBSZhKKCd4guirWxgj33hr3)_

Part of #23181 (slice 33). The card stays open for later slices: `plugin-auth/src/invitation-delivery-outcome.test.ts` (10.5 s) is left to slice 30's effect, and slices 29–32 hold other files.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：17 个非 cli 的服务端测试文件（verify ×6、runtime ×4、rest ×2、plugin-security ×3、plugin-auth ×2、service-automation ×1）。其中 4 个文件把多个用例重复执行的相同启动合并成一次（served-composition 3→1、sys-user-default-row-scope 10→2、meta-history-diff 20→1、meta-draft-read-builder-gate 21→1）；17 个文件都在第 2 行加 `// test-budget: 20` 头。
- **为什么改**：卡 #23181 的测试提速职责：CI 里超过 10 s 的测试文件要么提速，要么按裁决 6181973363 B 声明预算。这 17 个文件本地只跑 1.6–6.2 s，CI 读数 10–13 s 来自分片并发负载，剩下的地板是互不相同的真实工作。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试文件，六个包的 `files[]` 都只发 `dist`、README、CHANGELOG，不发布任何东西；用例名和断言一条没删、没放宽（4 个改动文件 base/head 用例名逐条一致，且在 3 个随机顺序种子下全过）；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/rest/src/meta-history-diff-authoring-door.test.ts`（共享启动 + 每例前清空 spy）；`packages/services/service-automation/src/sys-user-default-row-scope.integration.test.ts`（两个 `beforeAll`）；`packages/verify/src/harness.served-composition.test.ts`（共享的 plain 启动）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/meta-history-diff-authoring-door.test.ts` → 20/20 通过，文件行约 0.5 s（base 约 2.3 s）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The 17 files the order lists from slice 23's offender table (`pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s23/offenders-after-s23.md`), read from the default reporter's per-file module line in the Test Core shard logs of the scheduled `ci.yml` runs `41199450735`, `41217827347`, `41237094739`, `41255489006` and `41271604267`. "local" is the same file line from one run on this box (`--maxWorkers=1`, base `d94dd3a65d`).

| file | 0735 | 7347 | 4739 | 9006 | 4267 | local | tests | boots, base → head | cause | fix |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|:--|:--|

**Cause across the set.** Every file reads 1.6–6.2 s locally, and its CI readings spread two to four times across runs of the same code (`walled-owner-operator-stamp` 3.4 s and 11.9 s): the overrun is the Test Core shard's concurrent load on in-process work. No file spawns a CLI; none repeats a boot beyond the four fixed here.

**Headers** (ruling 6181973363 letter B, class `spawns the real producer once per single-cause fixture`, the class slice 26 used for in-process boots): N = the slowest of the five CI readings × 1.25, rounded up to 10 s; 20 for all 17. Where the file also changed, the header keeps its pre-change CI reading and says so. All 17 parse with `readTestBudget` (`scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`): 20 s, line 2.

**The shares.** Only where no case writes what another reads, as the order allows:
- `harness.served-composition`: the slate case and the cube control only read the kernel; the mail control's send leaves a `sys_email` row only it counts. Its own anti-vacuity line (`onePackage().requires` is undefined) stays.
- `sys-user-default-row-scope`: each case reads through its own producer, and asserts on the last `readContexts` entry its own read pushed and on the hook firing it counts from its own `before`. In the `extend` describe the second case's contribution is refused and the case itself pins that the registry is unchanged.
- The two rest files: after the seeding every case only reads (`GET` doors, `draftVersion`'s system read; the dataset door hands its query to the `queryDataset` spy, which stores nothing). The protocol spies (history-diff) and `queryDataset` (builder-gate) are cleared in `beforeEach`, as a fresh boot left them.

Not changed: no case name, assertion, timeout, tier or project; no source file; no shared helper or testkit (`verify/src/harness.ts`, `boot-warm-up.testkit.ts`, `default-organization.testkit.ts`, `audience-gate-test-support` untouched).

## Tests

- **A/B** (one box, one lock hold, base copied beside head as `zzbase.*`, each side in its own vitest invocation, order alternated per round, N=3, `--maxWorkers=1`, default reporter file line; copies deleted after):

  | file | base (s) | head (s) | change (mean) |
  |:--|:--|:--|--:|
  | `meta-history-diff-authoring-door` | 2.39, 2.29, 2.12 | 0.48, 0.45, 0.51 | −78.7% (2.27 → 0.48) |
  | `meta-draft-read-builder-gate` | 2.51, 2.35, 2.56 | 0.52, 0.56, 0.59 | −77.5% (2.47 → 0.56) |
  | `sys-user-default-row-scope.integration` | 2.75, 2.83, 2.45 | 0.87, 0.92, 0.73 | −68.5% (2.67 → 0.84) |
  | `harness.served-composition` | 4.83, 5.43, 5.35 | 3.41, 3.95, 3.51 | −30.4% (5.20 → 3.62) |

  Every run exit 0, the same test counts both sides (20, 21, 10, 7). `vitest list` on base and head gives the same case names for all four files.
- **Order independence of the shares:** each changed file run plain and with `--sequence.shuffle --sequence.seed=11`, `=22`, `=33`: 16 runs, all exit 0 (7/7, 10/10, 20/20, 21/21).
- **Header-only files:** all 13 run on base with the full count passing (local readings in the table); the header is a comment line.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed (test-only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Headers on files that read well under 10 s locally.** The 17 headers follow slice 26's precedent (PR #28599), which declared the same class on in-process files from their CI readings. The local readings are in the table so the seat can weigh it: on the four changed files the header carries the pre-change CI reading, and the next refresh reads the new shape.
- **`skip-changeset`.** Test-only. All six packages ship `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`; after the full build, a source symbol from each package is in its `dist/` (positive control: `bootStack`, `AutomationServicePlugin`, `RestServer`, `QuickJSScriptRunner`, `SecurityPlugin`, `AuthManager`) and a fixture string from each package's changed tests is not (`svc_note_cube`, `qa_star_reader`, `nav_atlas_launch_plan`, `spike_tree`, `qa_due_stored_`, `operator@corp.example`), nor is `test-budget:`. No `files[]` content changes.
- **Open lever, not taken here:** `rls-stored-list-ordering-fails-closed` (120 boots) and `org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture` (60) could share a boot per key only if their cases stopped reading the whole table, which would change what those assertions say; left as is.

## Verification

All readings on head `9f399f58` (one commit, then one merge of `origin/main` after slices 24, 25, 26 and 28 landed: #28610, #28601, #28599, #28616), after a full `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (118/118).

- **Derived gate families:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head → 54 families, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe, all exit 0 (with `git fetch --depth=1` of the commit the teardown-shape self-test names). `--ran` reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 54 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`. List: `pm-orders/server/evidence/23181-s33-gates-ran-9f399f58.txt` in the project files.
- **The 17 files on the final head:** 104/104, 12/12, 20/20, 28/28, 94/94, 7/7, 7/7, 60/60, 10/10, 59/59, 8/8, 13/13, 21/21, 13/13, 100/100, 63/63, 24/24 (table order), every run exit 0.
- **Typecheck:** `pnpm --filter` the six packages `run typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0.
- **Hand gates:** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the 17 files exit 0 (none of the six packages has a `lint` script; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's); `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` exit 0.
- **CI** families (Test Core, lint farm, type-check lanes) are read off this PR's check-runs by the seat.
